title: Two tenants choose the same raw key
prompt: A reporting API defines request identity as (authenticated tenant, Idempotency-Key). Tenant north uses key=shared-7 to create report north-r1; tenant south independently uses the same raw key to create report south-r1. Both are new requests, both receive HTTP 201, and both responses reach their respective clients. Event E1 is the north request; E2 is the south request. For each event, report the actual server HTTP status (null only if the scenario does not establish it), response_observed, business_effect_delta (new reports), external_effect_delta, and response_ref. Then report exactly report_count, north_report_count, and south_report_count in final_state.
